name: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer API v2
rate_limit: None stated; 137 requests at 2 req/s, 0 x 429, Cloudflare cache HIT on 131
fields_of_interest: per filing: tax_prd, formtype (0=990,1=990EZ,2=990PF), totrevenue, totfuncexpns, totcntrbgfts, totprgmrevnue, totassetsend, totliabend, totnetassetend, compnsatncurrofcr, pdf_url (68 fields for 990, 126 for 990-PF); org: latest_object_id, ntee_code, foundation_code
years_covered: Calvary: financial data tax_prd 201109-202309 (TY2010-TY2022); 202409 (TY2023) listed without data; TY2024 only as latest_object_id
coverage_gaps: tax_prd_yr is the year the period ENDS, not IRS tax year; search caps at 10,000 results / 400 pages (DC alone hits the cap; MD and VA ntee 5 c3 hit it); no object_id per filing; download-xml link is behind a Cloudflare browser challenge (HTTP 403)
